original_test_intent: Apply one explicitly selected reading and/or event-status operation to one supported sensor, verify only the approved fields changed, observe monitoring effects and restore the original state when required.
original_method: Master names 0x04/0x30 but supplies only the sensor number even though the command requires operation semantics and conditional data. Both source transports remain preserved and are non-executable as written.
manual_activity: Owner selects the supported sensor fields to mutate, approves every operation and data byte, defines the expected reading/event transition and provides exact restore and active-fault handling.
required_inputs: Validated sensor number and SDR identity
Conditional reading value, event data and assertion/deassertion masks
safety_requirements: Do not send a sensor-number-only request
Do not guess operation selectors or conditional data
Do not use sshpass or disable host-key verification
Capture reading, event status, enable and threshold context
Validate sensor support and all reserved bits
Read back both affected state classes
Do not re-arm, change thresholds/hysteresis or event enables as recovery
agent_execution_scope: Capture pre-state reading, event status and monitoring context
Display full bytes and impact for confirmation
Read back reading and event status
Observe expected event effect without clearing logs
Restore only through the approved vector
engineer_actions: Approve exact fields/bytes and expected monitoring effects

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Not fit for execution: it omits the operation byte and conditional payload, uses insecure SSH, and proposes unrelated wildcard evidence, so command success could neither identify nor verify the mutation.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: After fresh approval, use a protected builder for `0x04 0x30 <sensor> <operation> [reading/event/assert/deassert data required by that operation]`; never issue the truncated source/DeepSeek form, and read back through 0x2d/0x2b as applicable.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: The original command family, stated transport paths and 10/5 timing remain preserved; no operation or data bytes are fabricated.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Derive a sensor-capability-valid operation payload, preserve reading/event baselines, confirm the exact mutation, execute once, then verify each selected field and monitoring side effect before approved restoration.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds the omitted operation/data semantics, secure access, state oracle and recovery contract without changing Master.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Read-only queries are necessary evidence but do not satisfy the write objective; a completion code without field-specific readback does not prove the intended reading/event status was applied.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Wrong operation bits can fabricate readings, assert/deassert events or mask useful fault state, potentially affecting alerting and downstream automation.

project_override_considerations: A vendor API is equivalent only when it exposes the same selected reading/event-status fields, preserves exact pre/post and monitoring evidence, and records whether raw 0x04/0x30 or a named transport remains untested.
expected_evidence: Verified target/sensor/SDR identity and supported operations
Fresh approval with complete operation-dependent payload
Pre-state reading, event status, enable/threshold and logs
Monitoring/alert effect and immediate active-fault behavior
Approved restore and restored evidence when required

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: The source requests a high-impact 0x30 write but omits the mandatory operation semantics and accepts only transport success while clearing evidence. DeepSeek retains the truncated request, uses insecure access and proposes unrelated output. Review preserves the source and marks it conditionally executable only with a complete payload.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The command purpose and operation-field model are identifiable. Exact sensor, selected fields, values, expected effects, approval and recovery are project execution inputs, so review can complete without inventing them.

review_improvement: Makes the operation-dependent payload, affected state, monitoring blast radius, multi-source readback and exact confirmation/restore boundary explicit while rejecting a dangerous truncated command.
independent_technical_reasoning: 0x30 is not a one-parameter trigger: the operation byte selects whether reading, event data, assertion or deassertion state is modified, and the remaining payload depends on those selectors. Omitting it makes the request malformed or firmware-dependent. Safe verification must read both the numeric/status path and the event-status path, because changing one can generate or suppress monitoring evidence even if the other looks normal.
